title: Refresh governance assistant HumanGate audit tests and collect the four never-run test files
summary: Collected and passed all 4 previously never-run test files (41 tests) by migrating to absolute imports without adding __init__.py; refreshed all 7 failing governance/assistant/humangate/audit contract test files to align with canonical forwarded governance architecture and durable incident writer contracts; verified all 135 tests pass with 0 net production code changes.

four_never_collected_files_collected_and.import_mode: default import mode with absolute services.control_plane.bff... paths

expectation_classifications.changed_item: Replaced retired AuditExport command in 9 test functions with allowlisted low-risk action EscalateDiff (entity_type=EvolutionDecision, actor_roles=['operator'])
expectation_classifications.rationale: AuditExport was retired and replaced by live assistant tools. AuditExport 410 rejection is explicitly verified in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_receipt_only_retirement.py. Testing general assistant security (path traversal, secret scrubbing, boolean coercion, idempotency) requires a valid allowlisted action. No assertions weakened.

expectation_classifications.changed_item: Removed obsolete final_contract_idempotency keyword argument; removed retired HumanGate commands (HumanGateApprove, HumanGateReject, HumanGateRequestMoreEvidence, HumanGateExtendTtl, QuarterlyRankingRecommendationSubmit) from command catalog admission test, retaining live HumanGateRevoke
expectation_classifications.rationale: HumanGateApprove/Reject/RequestMoreEvidence/ExtendTtl were retired to /bff/approvals/{id}/decide. Rejections with 410 are covered by test_receipt_only_retirement.py:13 and test_bff_b5_001_security_hardening.py. Live command catalog only admits HumanGateRevoke. No assertions weakened.

POST /bff/audit/export route was retired; its 410 rejection is tested in test_receipt_only_retirement.py:88. Live audit engine writing is verified by test_runtime_action_writes_audit_action_visible_in_bff_audit. No assertions weakened.

Retired command SubmitStrategyAction/FinalDecision replaced with live governance command ApproveEvolutionDecision. Verifies exact same MISSING_APPROVAL_EVIDENCE / APPROVAL_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED typed error contract. No assertions weakened.

expectation_classifications.changed_item: Added autouse _owner_serves_approvals fixture stubbing approval_owner.call_owner to return seeded decisions
expectation_classifications.rationale: Commit 6631736ae forwarded approval reads to the remote governance owner via approval_owner.call_owner rather than local read_surface. In isolated contract tests, call_owner must be stubbed. No assertions weakened.

expectation_classifications.changed_item: Added per-test stub in test_governance_ledger_includes_decision_only_approval_entry to return _APPROVAL_3_DECISION_ONLY on /approvals call_owner, and updated expected source_dataset to 'approval_queue_items'
expectation_classifications.rationale: Under forwarded governance architecture (6631736ae), ledger entries for approvals derive from approval_queue_items fetched from the governance owner. No assertions weakened.

expectation_classifications.changed_item: Added create_incident and update_incident_status to GovernanceRuntimeRiskAuditTestReadPorts, and passed durable_writer=store to create_incident_router
expectation_classifications.rationale: Commit 82b69e4dd enforced that incident creation and status mutation require a durable writer instead of process-local memory. Test store now implements durable writer methods. No assertions weakened.

expectation_classifications.changed_item: Converted relative imports (from .policy import ...) to absolute imports (from services.control_plane.bff.auth.policy import ...)
expectation_classifications.rationale: Test file could not be collected in default import mode due to relative import beyond top-level package. Fixed without adding __init__.py.

expectation_classifications.changed_item: Converted relative imports to absolute imports (from services.control_plane.bff.auth...)
expectation_classifications.rationale: Test file could not be collected in default import mode due to relative imports. Fixed without adding __init__.py.

expectation_classifications.changed_item: Converted relative imports to absolute imports; updated test_non_approver_credentials_do_not_gain_review_authority so operator* role expects 200 (empty review list) while viewer expects 403
expectation_classifications.rationale: Per canonical services/governance/contract.md lines 362-365 and commit 6631736ae, operator roles have read visibility into reviews (returning 200 with empty list [] when none assigned) but lack review decision authority, while viewer roles receive 403. No assertions weakened.
